nonBlockingIssues.description: Comment says 'dequeues from the front of the queue' but Vec::pop() dequeues from the back (LIFO). Pre-existing, not introduced by this commit.
The `name` parameter in make_sensor/make_switch/make_select helpers is interpolated without escaping. Safe in practice because all callers use hardcoded string literals.
The `device_id` in unique_id fields is interpolated without escaping. Safe in practice because device IDs are always alphanumeric.
Warning log says 'capacity 2' but channel capacity was changed to 4. Cosmetic mismatch in diagnostic message.
Doc comment says 'Uses the Clock trait' but check() takes a raw u64, not a &dyn Clock. Minor doc inaccuracy.
find_header_value_start() has a misleading while-loop where search_from is never mutated. Should be simplified to an if-let block.
The `level` field is interpolated into JSON without escaping. Safe because level values are always hardcoded string literals ('error', 'warn', etc.).
RemoteLogEntry struct in launa-mqtt duplicates the shape of launa_core::LogEntry. Necessary because launa-mqtt doesn't depend on launa-core. Creates maintenance risk if fields diverge.
